description: Legal catalog of authoritative automotive repair knowledge sources for CRM/agent ingestion. Proprietary sources are indexed as acquisition targets, not copied content.

sources.name: Bosch Automotive Electrics and Automotive Electronics
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for electrical diagnosis theory; do not ingest pirated PDFs.

sources.name: Bosch Automotive Handbook, 11th edition
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Buy legal copy; ingest only if your license permits. Otherwise store as bibliography and use human-made notes.

sources.name: Diesel Engine Management: Systems and Components
sources.publisher: Springer Vieweg / Bosch Professional Automotive Information
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Useful for diesel diagnostics, DPF/EGR/injection theory.

sources.name: Gasoline Engine Management: Systems and Components
sources.publisher: Springer Vieweg / Bosch Professional Automotive Information
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Good for training the agent on gasoline engine principles; do not copy without license.

sources.name: Bosch Professional Automotive Information series
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Purchase legal eBooks/print; avoid pirated PDFs. Use summarized internal notes if license allows.

sources.name: ACDelco Technical Delivery System (TDS)
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; ingest GMSi documents and calibrations metadata under license.

sources.name: Audi erWin North America
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; use VIN-specific docs and keep document IDs.

sources.name: BMW Group Aftersales Online System (AOS)
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; index repair information by VIN, model series, engine and procedure ID.

sources.name: Honda ServiceExpress
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe and ingest only licensed documents; use VIN/year/model/trim filters.
sources.notes: Core source for Honda/Acura U.S. models.

sources.name: Hyundai Service Website
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; ingest licensed shop manuals/ETM/TSB with source/version metadata.

sources.name: JLR TOPIx
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Register independent operator; ingest licensed documents with model/VIN metadata.

sources.name: Kia Global Information System (KGIS)
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; ingest service manual/TSB/training only within license limits.

sources.name: Mazda Service Info
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; ingest workshop manual/WD/TSB under terms; use security data only where authorized.

sources.name: Mercedes-Benz StarTekInfo
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use official technical docs with VIN/model/body/engine filters.

sources.name: Motorcraft Service
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use subscriptions for repair/wiring/TSB; owner guides free where available.

sources.name: Nissan Publications / TechInfo
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use subscription for service manuals and TSBs; owner manuals are free via the portal where available.

sources.name: Subaru Technical Information System (STIS)
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; map content by model/year/engine/body.

sources.name: Toyota Technical Information System (TIS)
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; export/index only content allowed by subscription terms. Use links/citations per document.

sources.name: Volkswagen erWin North America
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe; ingest VIN-specific service information and wiring diagrams only within terms.
sources.notes: Core VW source for North American specs.

sources.name: NHTSA Datasets and APIs
sources.publisher: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
brands: All makes sold in U.S. where data exists
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use APIs for vehicle-specific lookup; use ZIP/CSV flat files for bulk indexing; refresh daily/weekly.
sources.notes: Best open source for U.S. recalls, complaints, investigations and manufacturer communications.

sources.name: NHTSA Manufacturer Communications / TSB Received ZIPs
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Download year-range ZIPs from the NHTSA page; keep original document URL as citation.
sources.notes: Use all year-range ZIPs, not only this sample URL.

sources.name: NHTSA Recalls Flat File
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Download ZIP; parse using RCL.txt data dictionary; refresh daily.

sources.name: NHTSA Technical Service Bulletins System Flat File
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Download ZIP; ingest summaries and document IDs; link to source PDFs instead of redistributing full OEM documents unless license allows.
sources.notes: Data.gov lists CSV format and U.S. public-domain license for the downloadable flat file.

sources.name: NHTSA vPIC Vehicle API
sources.publisher: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
brands: All makes where VIN/manufacturer submissions exist
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use DecodeVinValues/DecodeVinExtended and make/model endpoints. Cache VIN decode results.
sources.notes: Good first step for normalizing customer vehicle records by VIN.

sources.name: ALLDATA Repair Professional
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use professional subscription/API if available; do not scrape web UI.

sources.name: Autodata for Cars & Vans
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Acquire workshop license; integrate only through permitted exports/API.
sources.notes: Strong cross-brand source for independent workshops.

sources.name: Bosch ESI[tronic]
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Acquire commercial license; use vendor API/export only if contract permits; do not scrape client software.
sources.notes: Strong cross-brand diagnostic and repair source.

sources.name: MOTOR TruSpeed Repair
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Consider for API-based integration into CRM/agent workflows.
sources.notes: Good fit if you need structured data/API.

sources.name: Mitchell 1 ProDemand
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Acquire shop license; integrate through permitted vendor methods.

sources.name: TecAlliance TecDoc / Repair Data
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for parts identification + repair data integration, especially Europe/Kazakhstan import mix.

sources.name: Automotive Mechatronics
sources.publisher: Springer Vieweg / Bosch Professional Automotive Information
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Good for chassis/electronics systems understanding.

sources.name: SAE International Automotive Books
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Select titles relevant to your repair scope; store bibliographic metadata and legal notes.

sources.name: I-CAR Repairability Technical Support (RTS)
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Index as collision/ADAS/HV safety reference; link to OEM procedures rather than copying.
sources.notes: Valuable for collision repair and ADAS calibration routing.

sources.name: NASTF OEM Service Information Resources
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use as directory of OEM portals and secure-data workflows.
sources.notes: Good reference for U.S./Canada independent repairer access.

sources.name: BMW Technical Information System
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for North American BMW/MINI data.

sources.name: Citroën Service Box
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use official Service Box; ingest only licensed technical docs.

sources.name: Genesis Service Website
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for Genesis-specific manuals and TSBs.

sources.name: Mitsubishi Motors Service Information Retrieval
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe for service manuals; free emergency guides can be linked/indexed if permitted.
sources.notes: Useful for Mitsubishi imports and older models.

sources.name: Mopar TechAuthority
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Subscribe/purchase official docs; retain links and document IDs.

sources.name: New Dialogys
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use after proper registration/subscription.

sources.name: Peugeot Service Box
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use official Service Box; ingest only licensed technical docs.

sources.name: Porsche Technical Service Information / PIWIS TSI
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use official independent workshop route; avoid unofficial PDF mirrors.

sources.name: Renault ASOS / New Dialogys Documentation
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use New Dialogys documentation packs by duration; index by VIN and vehicle family.

sources.name: Stellantis Independent Operator Portal
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use as umbrella portal for Stellantis technical repair information.
sources.notes: Good starting point for Stellantis brands.

sources.name: Subaru Europe Tech-info
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for European-spec Subaru vehicles.

sources.name: Tesla Service Manuals
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Link/index public service manual pages; verify terms before bulk crawling; high-voltage content must be safety-gated.
sources.notes: Useful for EV repair knowledge and HV safety processes.

sources.name: Volvo Cars Technical Information Shop
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use when a direct VIDA/vehicle connection and Volvo technical data are needed.

sources.name: erWin Store Europe
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use market-specific portals for EU/RoW vehicles.

sources.name: FuelEconomy.gov Vehicles CSV
sources.publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency / Department of Energy
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Download ZIP CSV; normalize by year/make/model/engine/transmission. Refresh when EPA updates.
sources.notes: Useful for vehicle attribute enrichment and fuel/engine context.

sources.name: NHTSA Complaints Flat Files
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Download ZIP; parse using CMPL.txt; use for trend signals, not repair decisions.
sources.notes: Unverified consumer complaints; useful for pattern discovery only.

sources.name: Transport Canada Vehicle Recalls Database
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use official open data if accessible; otherwise link to Transport Canada recall search.
sources.notes: Useful for Canadian-market imports and North American models.

sources.name: UK DVSA Vehicle Recalls CSV
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Download CSV; use as non-U.S. recall supplement.
sources.notes: The public page provides all recalls since 1992 as CSV.

sources.name: OEM Electronic Parts Catalogs via manufacturer portals
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Treat each OEM EPC as separate licensed source; keep part revisions/supersession dates.
sources.notes: Use only official or licensed EPC providers.

sources.name: Partslink24
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for parts identification; integrate only through licensed routes.
sources.notes: Critical for CRM estimates and part matching.

sources.name: HaynesPro WorkshopData
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Acquire license; use for standardized repair instructions and fault-guided workflows.

sources.name: Identifix Direct-Hit
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for pattern-based diagnostics; separate confirmed fixes from OEM procedures in database.
sources.notes: Blend of OEM info and verified fix experience.

sources.name: MOTOR Technical Service Bulletins
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for near-real-time TSB API/data feed if licensed.

sources.name: ISO 14229-1 Unified Diagnostic Services
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for diagnostics architecture and terminology; do not copy standard text.
sources.notes: Core standard for ECU diagnostic services.

sources.name: ISO 15031 Road Vehicles OBD
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for emissions-related diagnostic interface concepts; do not reproduce standard text.

sources.name: ISO 15765 Diagnostics on CAN
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for scan-tool/ECU communication concepts.

sources.name: SAE J1979-2 OBDonUDS
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use as reference for standards-compliant scan-tool behavior; do not reproduce text.

sources.name: SAE Vehicle E/E System Diagnostic Standards Committee
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use catalog to identify standards; buy required standards for training/implementation.

sources.name: Isuzu RMI
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use mainly for Isuzu light/commercial vehicles in fleet/customer base.
sources.notes: Commercial vehicles, not passenger car focus.

sources.name: Mazda Manuals Australia
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for RHD/Australian Mazda variants.

sources.name: Mopar EU Technical Area
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for EU-market Stellantis/Fiat/Alfa/Jeep models.

sources.name: Opel / Vauxhall GME InfoTech
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use official Opel site linked from OEM/J2534 ecosystem; verify market coverage.
sources.notes: The provided URL is a pass-thru landing page linking to official Opel resources.

sources.name: Toyota Service Information & Repair Manuals Australia
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for RHD/Australia-spec imports when relevant.
sources.notes: Useful for right-hand-drive and market-specific differences.

sources.name: Volvo Car Bookstore / TechInfo
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Purchase training materials; ingest summaries/notes under license.
sources.notes: Training content rather than full repair DB.

sources.name: EPA Compliance and Fuel Economy Data
brands: Vehicles and engines in EPA datasets
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Ingest only fields useful for diagnostics and vehicle classification; keep dataset version/date.

sources.name: EU Safety Gate / RAPEX
brands: Passenger vehicles and non-food products with alerts
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Index vehicle-category alerts if the API/feed is available; otherwise use curated links.
sources.notes: Recall/defect safety signal, not a repair manual.

sources.name: KBA Recall Database
brands: Vehicles affected by German KBA recalls
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use as authoritative lookup; avoid scraping unless terms permit.
sources.notes: Useful for German and EU imports.

sources.name: NHTSA SaferCar Safety Ratings CSV
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Bulk ingest for vehicle context and safety metadata.
sources.notes: Not repair instructions; useful context for CRM and risk triage.

sources.name: ALLDATA DIY
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Useful for specific customer vehicle deep dives; not ideal as bulk database.

sources.name: Auto Repair Source
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Check whether business/CRM agent ingestion is permitted.

sources.name: ChiltonLibrary
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Useful if accessible via library/institution; check commercial use rights.

sources.name: Bosch Automotive Download Center
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for Bosch workshop equipment manuals and software documents.

sources.name: Bosch Automotive Training
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for staff upskilling; include course metadata only unless licensed.

sources.publisher: National Institute for Automotive Service Excellence
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use as skills taxonomy for agent curriculum; do not copy paid test prep.

sources.name: ASE Education Foundation
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use task lists as taxonomy if license permits.

sources.name: I-CAR Training
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for collision repair staff training and safety workflow design.

sources.name: Ford Owner Manuals
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Index maintenance and owner-level instructions if permitted.

sources.name: Honda Owner Manuals
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Index links and maintenance schedule pages where permitted.

sources.name: Kia Digital Owner Manuals
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for owner-facing explanations and maintenance reminders.

sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Useful for maintenance intervals and owner-facing CRM answers.

sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for part numbers/fitment context; verify locally.

sources.name: Toyota Parts and Service / EPC resources
sources.recommended_ingestion_route: Use for rough part lookup; verify through local supplier/dealer.
